messages:
linh_cs: PulsePoint QBR is next Tue. Onboarding spike — embedding requests jumped ~3x over last 48h. Need a quick spend forecast + immediate guardrail recommendation before the QBR. @tom_finops @anya_enable any bandwidth?

 tom_finops: Looking. Can you drop the 7d token delta and current projected burn? I can sketch budget scenarios.

 linh_cs: 7d delta: +2.9M embedding tokens. Projected 30d at current cadence: ~18M tokens (~$6.3k/mo at our hosted rates). But bursty — their weekly max would hit ~4x baseline. Alerts-bot fired last night: `embed_rate_alert`.

 alerts-bot: [system] embed_rate_alert triggered for account=pulsepoint severity=warning threshold=1000 rps

 anya_enable: For QBR I'd recommend a conservative throttle + enable caching on 1-2 heavy routes. Also run a short eval on model-switch quality (gpt-like vs distilled) to present tradeoffs.

 mike_data: Quick query I ran:
 ```
 SELECT SUM(tokens) AS tokens_7d FROM usage WHERE account='pulsepoint' AND feature='embeddings' AND ts >= now()-7d;
 ```
 Result: 2,950,321 tokens. I can produce a per-route breakdown by EOB.

 tom_finops: Options for slide:
 - short term: set alert at 150% baseline + 10% quota bump for onboarding (~owner: linh)
 - mid term: propose reserved capacity estimate and 10% commit ask in QBR (owner: tom)
 - cost save tech: enable prefix caching + suggest switching to smaller embedding model for similarity index (owner: anya)
 I'll draft numbers.

 linh_cs: I'll add a 'spend mitigation' slide and ask product for feedback capture. @mike_data can you export the top 5 embedding routes to include in the QBR appendix?

 mike_data: Yep — exporting now. ETA 60m.

 anya_enable: Also capture their comment re: latency when we suggested quantized variant last week — needs in-product note for engineering. I'll open a ticket.

 linh_cs: Great. Action items:
 - mike_data: export per-route usage + top 5 contributors (due in 60m)
 - tom_finops: draft 3 budget scenarios and reserve ask (due EOD)
 - anya_enable: create enablement talking points + open engineering ticket re: quantized latency feedback
 I'll send a 30min prep invite for tomorrow 10am PT and draft the QBR spend slide. :thumbsup:

 tom_finops: sounds good. ping me if you want conservative vs aggressive assumptions.

 linh_cs: Thanks all — I'll post the calendar and attach the draft when ready.
